origins.section: LinkedList Loses to ArrayList Unless You Already Hold the Position
ArrayDeque Is the Stack and the Queue; Stack Is a Synchronized Vector
Colliding HashMap Keys Stay Fast Only When They Are Comparable
TreeMap Answers "Which Key Is Nearest?", Compares with compareTo, and Returns Live Views

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-sorted-inserts: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sorted-inserts: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-sorted-inserts: Decided by: 'add(index, x) on a LinkedList is two steps. The link itself is O(1), but first node(index) walks from whichever end is closer, following one pointer per element', and the table at n=100000: get(i) 2.1 vs 35345.5 ns, add/remove mid 3895.0 vs 118217.7 ns.
recorded.prompt:q-back-button: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-back-button: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-back-button: Decided by 'push, pop, peek and poll all work on the head; add and offer work on the tail. Mixing the families turns the stack into a queue' and the output 'add a, b, c then pop, pop, pop: a b c'.
recorded.prompt:q-record-key-flood: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-record-key-flood: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-record-key-flood: Decided by 'HashMap uses compareTo only when the key's class implements Comparable of itself, as String does. A record wrapping a String isn't Comparable, so the tree has nothing to descend by' and the run: 138 vs 22482 ns per get.
recorded.prompt:q-distinct-amounts: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-distinct-amounts: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-distinct-amounts: Decided by 'A TreeMap or TreeSet compares keys with compareTo ... not with equals. BigDecimal 1.0 and 1.00 are not equal ... yet compareTo returns 0, so the TreeSet kept one of them' and the output 'TreeSet size 1'.
